title: Benchmark score (row of data/observations/scores.csv)
description: One reported number. Conflicting reports are all kept; never overwrite a row with a different source.

variant.description: Must be one of the benchmark's declared variants (e.g. humaneval: base|plus).

metric.description: Override of the benchmark's default metric.

harness_id.description: Harness/scaffold that produced the number; 'undisclosed' if the source does not say.

harness_version.description: Version/commit of the harness, as stated by the source.

setting.description: Harness options and eval settings that change the number, e.g. 'edit_format=diff', 'max_turns=100', '0-shot greedy', LiveCodeBench date window.

reasoning_effort.description: Effort level / thinking budget as stated by the source, e.g. 'high', 'budget=32k'.

quant.description: Weights precision used for the eval, if not native (e.g. Q4_K_M).
